description:
FILED s433 (Fable review probe; PRE-EXISTING).  SILENT WRONG: a file lexical promoted under its OWN name aliases the package variable of that name.

    my $y = 7;  sub nm { $y }  print "[$main::y]\n";       perl: []    PCL: [7]

WHY: Pl/Parser2.pm _promote_captured's IDENTITY branch (~line 3035: "A name with exactly ONE my/state binding file-wide can be renamed to the PLAIN package global $Pkg::name (no __file__N mangle)") counts only my/state DECLARATIONS when it decides "unique"; an explicit `$main::y` / `$::y` / `our $y` spelling of the same bare name in the file is not counted, so the lexical and the package variable share one cell.  The emission shows it: `(p-defcell main::$y ...)` for the qualified mention and `(p-defcell $y ...)` for the promoted lexical -- the same symbol under (in-package :main).  The branch is deliberate (v1's defvar model; string-eval resolution of the bare name) and `docs/ir-spec.md`'s cells row says "fresh name" -- it is not fresh in this branch; amend the row to say when.

FIX SHAPE: the identity condition ALSO requires that no package-global spelling of the bare name occurs in the file (qualified `$Pkg::name`/`$::name`, `our $name`; `${"..."}` symbolic cannot be seen -- accept, note it); otherwise mangle to $name__file__N as the non-unique case already does (the eval guard comes with the mangle, as the comment says).  Scoping/rename change -> the full sweep IS the gate (CLAUDE.md table) + gate-SET scan over both populations.

MEASURE FIRST: the population -- files where a unique captured/promoted lexical co-occurs with its package-global spelling (scan the four populations); the sweep rows that sit behind it, if any.

BAR: the reproducer + `our $y` spelling + `$::y` spelling + the inverse (a unique captured lexical with NO package spelling stays identity-promoted, byte-identical emission) vs perl; corpus-diff; sweep TOTAL/LOST; gate-SET; a Pl/t guard row.  Filler (plan-post-s433 Q7).


DONE s443e (Opus, agent E round 4), commit 37bd6f2, ff-merged s444.  ONE conjunct added: _scan_pkg_global_spellings (computed in parse() BEFORE the first rename; sigil-exact; glob marks all three; name-based not package-resolved) demotes the identity promotion to the $name__file__N mangle in BOTH passes; _ref_shadowed asks _stmt_binding so `our` masks.  12 silent-wrong shapes fixed, 9 inverses SAME, 4 populations/1123 transpiles with exactly ONE explained mover (local.t over-refusal, 303/13 both trees).  RESIDUES: (a) package-resolved variant of the scan if the mangle ever costs (today 1 file / 0 rows); (b) eval of a NON-interpolating string spelling $main::y â accepted hole, in not-supported.md; (c) the no-capture `my $y; { our $y; }` refusal is #519.  Sweep + gate-SET scan run by Fable over the merged batch (s444).
subject: A file lexical promoted under its OWN name (identity branch) aliases the same-named package variable: my $y + $main::y share one cell -- require no package spelling, else mangle
